answer: Count votes the way Stellar does, with quorum slices. Each agent publishes a short list of peers it trusts, and a decision settles only when a quorum built from those slices agrees. A farm can spin up 10,000 keys, but they stand on a ledge outside every honest slice, so their votes never join a quorum. Sybils that trust only each other find no haven either: their quorum never intersects the network's. There is no velvet rope to buy past; a newcomer gains weight only when real peers add it to their slices.
